title: Create a two-question web knowledge test
goal: implements answer feedback, cumulative scoring and question change, and displays the results after completing the test.
summary: question array stores the question stem, options and the subscripts of the correct options. Use the current question number to find the corresponding question, and use a separate score to save the score of the entire test. The rendering function is responsible for updating the content when changing topics.
tasks: Add click monitoring to #quiz-options in script.js. Find the option button, use Number to convert its data-choice into a subscript, and then compare it with the correct of the current question.

When the answer is correct, add 1 to the score and display "answered correctly.". When the answer is wrong, press the format of "The correct answer is "#gallery"." to display the correct option of the current question. Write the total score as #quiz-score.
After answering, disable all options for this question so that each question is scored only once. Enables the "Next question" or "View results" button.
Update question number when #quiz-next is clicked. When there is the next question, call the existing showQuestion() and retain the accumulated score.
When the quiz ends, show "test ended" in the question heading, clear the options, and disable the result button. Display "Score: N / 2", where N is the number of correct answers.

example.note: Pass in the current points for garbage classification exercise. After checking for correct classification, the function returns the updated cumulative points.

hint: If the second question is also answered correctly but only has 1 point, check whether you write score = 1 each time. Only 1 will be added to the original score for each correct answer, and the score will be retained when changing questions.
